issue.title: Bug: PDDF gpio device initialization failure

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

See https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/23669#issuecomment-3450190028

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/23669 introduced a regression which only hit on PDDF platforms which used the previous GPIO component.

This was due to the `create_gpio_device` name of the new and existing method being the same. The new method has a different number of parameters, which led to this error.

The fix is to make unique names for the different versions of `create_gpio_device`.

### Steps to Reproduce

On PDDF platforms using the GPIO module, the initialization will hit this error

```
Oct 27 <IPV6> sonic pddf_util.py[1183]: File "/usr/local/bin/pddfparse.py", line 1898, in dev_parse
Oct 27 <IPV6> sonic pddf_util.py[1183]: return self.gpio_parse(dev, ops)
Oct 27 <IPV6> sonic pddf_util.py[1183]: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
Oct 27 <IPV6> sonic pddf_util.py[1183]: File "/usr/local/bin/pddfparse.py", line 1694, in gpio_parse
Oct 27 <IPV6> sonic pddf_util.py[1183]: ret = getattr(self, ops['cmd']+"_gpio_device")(dev, ops)
Oct 27 <IPV6> sonic pddf_util.py[1183]: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
Oct 27 <IPV6> sonic pddf_util.py[1183]: TypeError: PddfParse.create_gpio_device() missing 1 required positional argument: 'ops'
Oct 27 <IPV6> sonic systemd[1]: pddf-platform-init.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
Oct 27 <IPV6> sonic systemd[1]: pddf-platform-init.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.
Oct 27 <IPV6> sonic systemd[1]: Failed to start pddf-platform-init.service - PDDF module and device initialization service.
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

There should be no error.
